gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-soyom: Funnel Display draws every letter like a single strand of spaghetti, and that gives it a skimming ease. Noto Sans Soyombo is the plain sans underneath, with a tall x-height that would crowd a heading made small.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-sunuw: Noto Sans Sunuwar reads friendly and open, its curves leaving daylight like a rope's bight. Funnel Display above it keeps one steady line width, and the sans-serif text would drift along easily beneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-sylot: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri stands short in its ascenders and tall in the body. Funnel Display is best at round bowls that never swell or thin, while the sans below it is best at keeping an open a.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-syria: Noto Sans Syriac Western reads modern and clean, with terminals held far from the stroke. Its best quality as a pair is the gap between Funnel Display's bent-straw lines and that dense, cable-thick sans.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tagal: Not one hairline or swell appears in Funnel Display. Noto Sans Tagalog supplies the other half, a sans-serif whose middle zone dominates each line and whose generous curve gaps keep that texture open.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tagba: Noto Sans Tagbanwa reads clean and modern, its lowercase filling most of the height. Funnel Display does vinyl-cut single-width headlines best, and Noto Sans Tagbanwa does open-curved plain sans text best.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tai-l: Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes before they ever touch. Funnel Display builds each letter from one stroke width, so the plain sans body can stay at a modest size and still hold its own.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tai-t: Chalk-board lowercase meets a sign-shop heading. Funnel Display has crossbars as thick as its stems, while Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its sans-serif lowercase toward the capital line and keeps every c plainly visible across a page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tai-v: Approachable and professional in the text, expressive and commanding up top, the two make a confident pairing. Funnel Display set small would lose its swagger beside Noto Sans Tai Viet.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-takri: Funnel Display looks traced in a single thickness, bold and loose at once, with low contrast in its capitals. Noto Sans Takri has unclosed round letters, so the sans-serif text should read smoothly.
